name: University of Ioannina
summary: Ioannina public university with 23 undergraduate departments taught in Greek and entered through the Ministry; no English-taught bachelor's.

ib.text: EU citizen with the IB: apply in the Ministry's foreign-school graduates category (one parent not of Greek origin, last two school years abroad); no exam, ranked on certificate grade; Greek B2 needed to enrol.

lastYear.text: apply online 2–9 July; courier postmark by 10 July

apply.via: Ministry of Education form for foreign-school graduates

notes: Its undergraduate page says the university entry process is determined by the Ministry of Education; nothing on the site offers an English-taught degree.
English modules exist only for incoming Erasmus+ students, for example in the Department of Economics.
